summary.text: Tommy John Schiavoni, listed by Ballotpedia as Thomas Schiavoni, is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 1 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is a former high school social studies teacher.

paragraphs.text: Schiavoni received a bachelor's degree in secondary education in social studies from the State University of New York at Cortland and a master's degree from the State University of New York at Stony Brook.
His career experience includes working as a high school social studies teacher.
Schiavoni assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Fred Thiele.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Agriculture, Alcoholism and Drug Abuse, Environmental Conservation, Local Governments, and Veterans' Affairs.
